card.name: Partway through names and citations
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece in the middle of a word or reference, such as the 'ac' in antacids, a brand-name syllable, or digits in a year or ISBN. Seen in drug-interaction text and in book citations.

modes.label: Inside drug words
modes.description: Middle piece of a drug class or brand name, such as antacids, aerosol or CLOZARIL.
